sentences.text: This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
ORDER The applicant has filed this FIRST bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 17.4.2023 by Police Station- Physical, District- Shivpuri, in connection with Crime No.278/2022, for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376, 376(2)(CHA) of the IPC and Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act.
It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is suffering confinement since 17.04.2023 and looking to the nature of allegations, no custodial interrogation is required.
It is further submitted that case is of consent prima facie as reflected in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. as well as before the Medical Officer.
One more fact referred by the counsel for the applicant is stay of four months of the prosecutrix with the applicant without raising any alarm.
Confinement amounts to pretrial detention.
He learnt the lesson hard way and would mend his ways and would become a better citizen.

He undertakes to cooperate in trial as well as investigation and would make Mahendra Alias Monti vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43509389/
1 himself available as and when required.

entities.text: Mahendra Alias Monti vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He would not be a source of embarrassment or harassment to the complainant.
Under these grounds, he prayed for bail.
Learned Public Prosecutor for the State as well as learned counsel for the complainant opposed the prayer and prayed for its dismissal.
Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the documents appended.

Considering the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and fact situation, a chance be given to the applicant for course correction, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
